infantry.line: To fight with Ben McCulloch and the Texas infantry
stanza: We signed up in San Antone, my brother Paul and me
To fight with Ben McCulloch and the Texas infantry
Well the poster said we'd get a uniform and seven bucks a week
The best rations in the Army and a rifle we could keep

infantry.line: Stormed in the New Highland Light Infantry
stanza: When I woke, he was gone
Calling, Where in the hell are the rest of your fellow
Stormed in the New Highland Light Infantry
